lee: blocker: KV cache seems to thrash when sequences > 8k and concurrent slot stealing happens; reproducer attached.

```
./bench/run_workload --model=resnet-x --seq=10240 --concurrency=32 --iters=300
# p50 18ms, p95 45ms, p99 220ms
```

ci-bot: CI status: microloop-refactor — build ✅, integration tests ⏳ (4/6)

anya: for observability, we should emit kv.evictions_per_min + kv.hot_prefetch_hit to make alerting easier.
